simple.summary: נָזִיד (nâzîyd) means something boiled , i.e. soup First listed occurrence: 2Kgs 4 38.

definitions.full: H5138. nazid נָזִיד noun [masculine] thing sodden or boiled, pottage ; absolute ׳נ Gen 25:29 4 t.; construct נְזִיד 25:34 ; — a kind of boiled leguminous food, object of וַיָּ֫זֶד 25:29 (see זוּד Hiph`il ); defined 25:34 as עֲדָשִׁים נְזִיד (see עדשׁ ); object of בַּשֵּׁל 2Kin 4:38 ; boiled in a סִיר 4:39 compare 4:40 ; mentioned, apparently as a common food, Hag 2:12 . זִיזָה זִיזָא זִיז, see below I. זוז . זִיזָא see זִיזָה below I. זוז .
